The two plots share the same y-axis, which is labeled "BLEU" and has a linear scale, ranging from 28.0 to 28.5 with a tick label interval of 0.1. The left plot has an x-axis labeled "α" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 with a tick label interval of 0.2, while the right plot has an x-axis labeled "p" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 with a tick label interval of 0.1 and additional tick labels at 0.15, 0.25, 0.35. 

The left plot illustrates the relationship between "α" and "BLEU", with a single blue line marked by circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately (0.1, 28.0) and increasing to a peak at around (0.5, 28.55), then decreasing to about (0.9, 28.1). 

The right plot shows the relationship between "p" and "BLEU", with a single blue line marked by circular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately (0.05, 28.3), increasing to a peak at around (0.15, 28.55), then decreasing to about (0.25, 28.4), followed by a slight increase to around (0.35, 28.45), and finally decreasing to approximately (0.45, 28.4).
